description: OpenNova Launcher patches: Unlock Prime, Strip 14 Spyware/Ad vectors, Eliminate Paywall, S24/S25 Hardware & Technical Minimal

patches.name: Unlock Prime

patches.name: Remove 14 Spyware & Ad Networks

patches.name: Eliminate Paywall

patches.name: S24/S25 Hardware & Technical Minimal Theme

release_notes:
### OpenNova Launcher v1.0.0 Release (Unified Repo)

- **Repository**: [mich-de/openlauncher](https://github.com/mich-de/openlauncher)
- **Morphe Source**: Import into Morphe Manager using `mich-de/openlauncher` or [One-Tap Deep Link](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=mich-de/openlauncher).
- **Pre-patched APK**: Standalone signed `OpenNovaLauncher.apk` (Tested on Samsung Galaxy S24, 0 trackers detected, Prime unlocked, S24/S25 120Hz LTPO optimized).
- **Icon Pack**: `TechnicalMinimalIconPack.apk` with Teenage Engineering / Nothing OS dot-matrix aesthetic.
- **Morphe Bundle**: `patches-1.0.0.mpp`, `patches-bundle.json`, `patches-list.json`.
